4279-5687-5931--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-5931--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1432-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-1724.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
The amount of +1/+1 counters on Sekki plus the number of other Spirits you control is at least eight.
413-1724.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, targeting Sekki. Sekki will prevent the 1 damage that would be dealt to it and instead removes a +1/+1 counter from it and creates a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 until Sekki dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sekki enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

997-2459-3184.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

511-817-4050-7803-7824.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-4050-7803-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

849-2946-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2946-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4478-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4478-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4478-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1494-5437-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

630-2366-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

141-6798-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6798-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4968-5902-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-5902-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

539-3045-3293-6620.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-6620.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-6620.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

261-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3869-4067-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-2292.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2584-4133-5686.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Shilgengar is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1849-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1849-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1170-1645-4826-5334-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2011-2060-6113.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 5 or greater, does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-2060-6113.description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler as an attacker, along with any number of Warrior(s) if desired.
If you declared one or more Warrior(s) as attackers, Najeela triggers, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Crystalline Crawler.
Quilled Greatwurm triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-2060-2926-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Traveling Minister does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Traveling Minister.
1274-2060-2926-3525.description:
Activate Traveling Minister by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life and giving target creature +1/+0 until end of turn.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Traveling Minister.
Repeat.

618-1874-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-1874-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

2-1283-1651-2499.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
2-1283-1651-2499.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less and by tapping Ancestral Statue, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value of zero, this combo nets infinite mana, which would allow you to instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1741-1770-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1741-1770-1987-2493.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries.
When Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Archaeomancer trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

394-2034-3537-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
394-2034-3537-4484.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-1987-3075-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1283-1987-3075-3227.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1623-1624-2125.description:
Cast Temporal Extortion for {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Temporal Extortion triggers, allowing any player to pay half of their life to counter the spell.
Pay half of your life to counter Temporal Extortion, exiling it and allowing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Repeat steps 2-3 until you have one life remaining and the Temporal Extortion trigger is on the stack.
Choose not to pay half of your life to counter Temporal Extortion, allowing it to resolve.
If any of your opponent choose to pay half of their life to counter the spell, Guile will exile it and allow you to cast it again.
Repeat steps 5-6 until none of your opponent choose to counter Temporal Extortion.
Move to the upkeep step of your extra turn.
Near-Death Experience triggers, winning you the game.
